_about: Measured official-test pass rates per module, consumed by scripts/generate-capability-matrix.mjs. Entries are added ONLY from actual sweep runs (never derived from the capability matrix itself, never estimated). Update an entry when its module is re-swept, and record the new date and source. Method for all entries unless noted: each test-<module>-* file in parity/node-test/parallel run via parity/preload.mjs with PARITY_TARGET=<module>, 30s timeout per file; counts are raw (entries in parity/expected-failures.shim.json are NOT subtracted).
